stories.title: Liberty's Jones lifts Team Spoon, wins All-Star MV...
stories.summary: Jonquel Jones won game MVP honors after scoring 22 points and falling two assists shy of a triple-double to help Caitlin Clark and Team Spoon defeat Team Coop 129-122 in the WNBA All-Star Game.

stories.title: 49ers' Shanahan to be limited in camp after crash
stories.summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan suffered significant injuries in a car crash during his summer break in mid-July that will leave him limited as the team opens training camp.

stories.title: LeBron decision came down to wire, agent says
stories.summary: Rich Paul called the lead-up to LeBron James' decision to join the Sixers an "emotional roller coaster" that didn't end until early Friday morning.

stories.title: WNBA's Engelbert mum on job status for 2027
stories.summary: Cathy Engelbert was noncommittal when asked if she expects to remain WNBA commissioner next season following months of increased scrutiny over her leadership.

stories.title: Joshua survives 2 knockdowns, KOs Prenga in 2
stories.summary: Anthony Joshua marked his return to the ring with a dramatic Round 2 knockout victory over Kristian Prenga on Saturday.
